data.name: Arjansh
data.gender_notes: Arjansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arjansh is derived from the Sanskrit language, where 'arj' means 'brave' and 'ansh' means 'descendant'. This name is associated with the great warrior Arjuna from the Mahabharata. It symbolizes the courage and victorious spirit of the warrior class in Hindu tradition. The name Arjansh carries the meaning “Brave and Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjansh usually hope their child will grow to embody brave and victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arjansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave and Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjansh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: Arjansh is a powerful and evocative name in Hindu culture, as it is the name of a revered hero from ancient Hindu texts. Arjuna, the namesake, is regarded as one of the greatest warriors in Hindu mythology. The name Arjansh upholds the valor, bravery, and prowess in battle synonymous with the warrior Arjuna. In contemporary times, parents may give their child this name to instill a sense of strength and courage.
data.spiritual_significance: Arjansh has deep spiritual significance as it is rooted in the noble character of Arjuna from the Mahabharata. Arjuna, one of the five Pandava brothers, is known for his unwavering devotion to Lord Krishna and his commitment to the path of righteous living. The name "Arjansh" signifies not just the warrior spirit, but also a person's connection to the divine, a reminder of one's duty towards God and dharma, and the inner strength to overcome all challenges in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Arjansh: Radiance of Arjuna, symbolizing inner strength and wisdom in the face of adversity. The name reverberates the valor and dedication of the legendary warrior, inspiring one to walk the path of truth and righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Arjansh is believed to be a derived name from Arjuna, a significant character in Hindu epic Mahabharata. Arjuna was a great warrior, one of the five Pandava brothers, and a central figure in the epic battle of Kurukshetra.

The suffix '-sh' in Arjansh is likely derived from the Persian influence during the Maurya and Gupta Empires in India, where it was used to signify 'son of'. This suffix is also found in other Hindu names such as Krishna's son Prithu Shaw or Prithus, and Chandragupta Maurya, among others.
